name: ajaia-docs
description: Lightweight collaborative document editor: Angular UI + Express/SQLite API

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix ajaia-docs-api ci && npm --prefix ajaia-docs-ui ci
scripts.dev: npx -y concurrently@9 -n api,ui -c blue,green "npm --prefix ajaia-docs-api run dev" "npm --prefix ajaia-docs-ui start"
scripts.build: npm --prefix ajaia-docs-ui run build && npm --prefix ajaia-docs-api run build
